scope: Public guidance and reversible implementation proposals. No owner observations, learned priors, causal outcomes or runtime certification.

added.why_distinct: A quota interruption can make a smaller successful sample look like index loss.
A healthy page today does not explain which revision Google indexed.
A crawl timestamp cannot establish the deployed revision or treatment exposure.
A claimed Googlebot user agent is not enough to identify Google traffic.
An initial response can be healthy while a critical script or data request fails.
A truncated sitemap response silently changes the index denominator.
A public repository may be hard to find under the terms its users recognize.
A decorative image can obscure what a shared repository actually does.
Rolling traffic exports overlap and cannot be added as independent weeks.
Own automation can coincide with a clone spike without revealing who cloned.
A tool can return full structured data while its text hides the steps or limits.
The first page of tools or resources is not necessarily the full inventory.
A transport error and an empty domain result require different next steps.
A discoverable resource URI may still be unusable in the intended client.
An advertised read-only hint cannot authorize a write or make returned content trusted.
A new protocol may duplicate a simpler interface without improving the task.
A short @id link can be misdiagnosed as a missing-name or missing-license object.
Matching labels can wrongly merge concepts from different domains.
A derived-from relation does not say a result is true or independently verified.
A language-tagged entity label does not create a localized answer page.
An interactive example loses its value if the visitor cannot return to the same inputs.
A saved badge can hide data that will disappear on eviction or a new device.
A successful download click is not the useful outcome promised by the page.
A local time input can be interpreted in a different zone by the provider.
Readers may benefit from a maintained artifact without revisiting a catalog.
A reusable sample can accidentally include private inputs or unsupported redistribution rights.
Filtered page/query rows may not reproduce property totals or reveal all demand.
A successful release and a rising chart do not isolate the reason for the movement.

reuse_instead_of_duplicate.idea: Special AI schema or llms.txt as a ranking shortcut
reuse_instead_of_duplicate.decision: Do not add a rule; reuse access, snippet and optional llms-index patterns. No provider ranking support.

reuse_instead_of_duplicate.idea: More internal links for every unknown-to-Google URL
reuse_instead_of_duplicate.decision: Reuse bounded internal discovery; require an actual missing useful path before changing a site.

reuse_instead_of_duplicate.idea: A large new agent gateway or recommendation score
reuse_instead_of_duplicate.decision: Defer platform expansion; first test a real task against the existing HTML and MCP paths.

reuse_instead_of_duplicate.idea: A page for every query or translated label
reuse_instead_of_duplicate.decision: Reject keyword-only expansion; use existing intent ownership and real translated-answer coverage.

reuse_instead_of_duplicate.idea: Pilot one reusable recipe inside the strongest existing page
reuse_instead_of_duplicate.decision: Reuse arwp-experiments-useful-artifact; this proposal adds no distinct implementation contract.

reuse_instead_of_duplicate.idea: Show where a useful recommendation changes with constraints
reuse_instead_of_duplicate.decision: Reuse arwp-comparisons-decision-threshold; this proposal adds no distinct implementation contract.

reuse_instead_of_duplicate.idea: Pilot review only when an answer-changing dependency moves
reuse_instead_of_duplicate.decision: Reuse arwp-governance-review-trigger; this proposal adds no distinct implementation contract.

reuse_instead_of_duplicate.idea: Stop expansion when the next page has no distinct useful job
reuse_instead_of_duplicate.decision: Reuse arwp-architecture-intent-owner; this proposal adds no distinct implementation contract.
